name: v1.2.3-r3_vieo_temporary_deployment
major_changes: one RUN_LANG switch resolves data, classes, prompts, trajectories, training, evaluation and report paths
English is newly generated under an isolated output root; Chinese remains under the configured Chinese branch
real classes.txt is read automatically and an exact-id zh-en mapping template is generated
settings.scene_disjoint.json is no longer required; dataset root is resolved from user_config
B0/B1/B2 evaluation uses four independent single-GPU vLLM replicas and deterministic SHA256 shards
LoRA SFT uses four-GPU DDP while preserving effective global batch
shared Omni remains one physical endpoint with TP=4 and three independent logical message contexts
original independent Reasoner/Perceiver/Verifier three-service topology is retained
B0, B1, B2 and safe workflows are exposed through one command file
support bundle collection excludes weights and images and redacts common secret patterns
training contract and runtime trainable-parameter reports are emitted
no silent fallback from missing BASE_SETTINGS
offline conda-pack migration guide and environment checker are included
B2 direct-prefix pairing audit prevents accidental Direct-data drift
post-training adapter safetensors scope audit verifies visual-encoder freezing evidence
pipeline summary aggregates Socratic funnel, rejection reasons and stage counts without treating missing artifacts as zero
LLaMA-Factory commands prefer python -m llamafactory.cli to avoid stale migrated shebangs
shared Omni fast profile remains bounded at concurrency 4 and memory utilization 0.92 until real-server benchmark
fixes: safe flows auto-build or validate scene-disjoint dataset
Chinese output root can be configured as a flat v1.2.3 directory
evaluation performs key-specific merged-model preflight before replicas
remove all downstream shell command substitution for taxonomy classes paths
read active taxonomy directly from generated settings in data and Socratic stages
add Python-layer recovery for legacy multi-line shell-polluted classes_file values
add strict active-taxonomy preflight and report before data conversion
add runner-root identity guard so a new command script cannot dispatch into a stale re_scripts tree
add doctor/install fingerprint command and r3 source verifier
force active settings release_revision=r3 before data/train/eval stages
configurable shared Omni tensor parallel size with TP2 default
vLLM 0.11.0 CLI checks use environment Python and serve --help=all
evaluation model-key dynamic-scope contamination fix included
scientific_limit: B0/B1/B2 remain the original RS-EoT student-model chain; Qwen3-Omni fine-tuning target is not implemented by this deployment profile.
